precheck.description: foreign key exists without ON DELETE CASCADE
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM pg_constraint
              WHERE conname = 'findingSource_findingId_fkey'
                AND conrelid = 'public."findingSource"'::regclass
                AND confdeltype <> 'c'
            )

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."findingSource"
            DROP CONSTRAINT "findingSource_findingId_fkey",
            ADD CONSTRAINT "findingSource_findingId_fkey"
              FOREIGN KEY ("findingId")
              REFERENCES "public"."finding" ("id")
              ON DELETE CASCADE

postcheck.description: findingId foreign key uses ON DELETE CASCADE
postcheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM pg_constraint
              WHERE conname = 'findingSource_findingId_fkey'
                AND conrelid = 'public."findingSource"'::regclass
                AND confdeltype = 'c'
            )
